title: Schools
subtitle: Partner schools, referral codes and verified paid students.

bulk.suspendBody: Suspended schools stop attributing new students until reactivated.

deleteBody: The school, its referral code and attribution history will be removed. Settlements already paid are kept for accounting.
contractEndBeforeStart: Contract end must be after the start date
codeFormat: Use 4–16 capital letters, digits or dashes

detail.referralHint: Students who register with this code are attributed to the school.

detail.progressSub: Current calculation period under the active school rule

detail.topTier: Highest tier reached — every new student earns the top rate.

rules.title: Incentive Rules
rules.subtitle: Versioned reward rules that power school and marketer settlements.
rules.draftCreated: Draft v{{version}} created from the active rule
rules.activateBody: The current active version will be marked superseded and kept in history. New settlements will use this version from its effective date.
rules.readOnlyHint: Active and superseded versions are locked. Create a new version to change the rule.
rules.thresholdHint: Minimum verified paid students in the period before any reward is earned.
rules.calculatorSub: Enter a number of verified paid students to see the computed reward.
rules.notQualified: Below the qualification threshold — no reward.

validation.toBeforeFrom: Tier {{n}}: “to” must be greater than or equal to “from”
validation.gap: Tier {{n}} must start at {{expected}} (no gaps or overlaps)
validation.openNotLast: Only the last tier can be open-ended
validation.firstFrom: The first tier must start at the qualification threshold ({{threshold}})

rules.scheduleBody: This version starts on {{date}}. It will be scheduled and switch on automatically; the current active version stays in force until then.
rules.scheduled: Version v{{version}} is scheduled to start on {{date}}
rules.noVersions: No versions yet. Create the first version to start rewarding partners.

settlements.title: School Settlements
settlements.subtitle: Monthly incentive payouts computed from verified paid students.
settlements.marketerSubtitle: Commission and milestone payouts for field marketers.
settlements.approveBody: The payout will move to finance for transfer.
settlements.payBody: Confirm that the transfer to the partner has been completed. This cannot be undone.
settlements.generateBody: Applies the incentive rule effective for the period to every qualifying partner.
settlements.generateNote: Existing pending settlements for the same partner and period are recalculated. Approved and paid settlements are never changed.
settlements.bulkPayTotal: Total to be marked as paid: {{amount}}
